title: Frictionless fiends outpouring it seems motions not stoppped momentum slowed. Slowed momentum stopped not motions seems it outpouring fiends frictionl
summary: Frictionless fiends outpouring it seems motions not stoppped momentum slowed. Slowed momentum stopped not motions seems it outpouring fiends frictionless #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Frictionless fiends
outpouring it seems
motions not stoppped
momentum slowed.
Slowed
momentum stopped
not motions
seems it
outpouring fiends
frictionless
#smallpoems
